lengthGroups.name: CSI pairs, P4 side
lengthGroups.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Camera and CSI-2: Espressif HDG §1.4.6 pair-to-pair ≤ 30 mil (0.762 mm) end to end; each lane is two segments in series (U6 → 0 Ω links R45–R47/R49–R51 → J4), so each segment gets 0.381 mm (pair means)

lengthGroups.name: CAM pairs, FPC side
lengthGroups.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Camera and CSI-2: Espressif HDG §1.4.6 pair-to-pair ≤ 30 mil (0.762 mm) end to end; each lane is two segments in series (0 Ω links → J4 here), so each segment gets 0.381 mm (pair means)

lengthGroups.name: RMII data, long segments
lengthGroups.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Ethernet and PoE isolation (derivation: docs/hardware/ethernet.md, Timing): the ESP32-P4 publishes no RMII output delay (IP101G DS p.61 and RMII 1.2 §7.4 give the rest), so the board takes a budget of 1.0 ns (5 % of the 20 ns period, a heuristic) for the MAC clock branch plus one TX line: (60 + 80) mm × 7.1 ps/mm = 0.99 ns, so ≤ 80 mm per line; no spread limit is needed, 80 mm fills the required field

paths.name: REF_CLK branches
paths.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Ethernet and PoE isolation (derivation: docs/hardware/ethernet.md, REF_CLK branches): from the star at R13 pin 2, no ledge forms at U1 pin 10 (near end) while the round trip to U6 pin 68 is no longer than the fastest RMII edge (1 ns, RMII 1.2 §7.4.3): ΔL ≤ 1 ns / (2 × 7.1 ps/mm) = 70 mm, minus 10 mm reserved for the module's internal trace = 60 mm. RX/TX timing allows ≈ ±420 mm (IP101G p.61, RMII 1.2 §7.4). IP101G §6.1 'equal' is met by this tolerance

paths.name: BOOT stub
paths.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, MCU and USB: the BOOT strap R39 and pull-up R38 sit on the 50 MHz RMII_TXD1_MCU line, so their stubs stay ≤ 3 mm (≈ 17 ps, negligible against the edge time; project heuristic)

viaParity.name: CSI lanes, P4 side
viaParity.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Camera and CSI-2: TI SPRAAR7J §3.9 p.12 equal via count on both members of a pair; the six 0 Ω links sit in U6 order (the ESP32-P4 cannot remap lanes or swap P/N: TRM v0.7 Register 42.2 p.2611), so each CSI leg has one via, F.Cu stub from its link's south pad to the via field at y 113.4 (D0_N at (136.75, 112.85)), each with a GND return via ≤ 0.95 mm; counted per side of the 0 Ω links

viaParity.name: CAM lanes, FPC side
viaParity.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Camera and CSI-2: TI SPRAAR7J §3.9 p.12 equal via count on both members of a pair; each CAM leg has two vias (one under J4 north of its pad, one north of its link at y 110.5), each with a GND return via ≤ 0.95 mm, and does the lane-order crossing on B.Cu; counted per side of the 0 Ω links

copperArea.name: U4 IN1 vias
copperArea.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Power: TPS2121 SLVSEA3F §12.1 vias under the input and output pins, §12.2 layout example p.33 draws two vias per IN pin; land pattern p.39 'VIA TYP' in pads 1, 2, 7, 8; ≈ 1.8–2 A input (one via per ampere)

copperArea.name: U4 IN2 vias
copperArea.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Power: TPS2121 SLVSEA3F §12.1 vias under the input and output pins; land pattern p.39 'VIA TYP' in pads 1, 2, 7, 8

copperArea.name: U4 OUT vias
copperArea.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Power: TPS2121 SLVSEA3F §12.1 vias under the input and output pins, §12.2 layout example p.33 draws four vias on OUT; land pattern p.39 'VIA TYP' in pads 1 and 8; ≈ 1.8–2 A output (one via per ampere)

copperArea.name: U10 exposed pad vias
copperArea.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, LED driver and ring: TPS61170 DRV0006A land pattern p.35, two thermal vias 1.1 mm apart in the exposed pad (§11.3); counts vias inside U10's pad box

copperArea.name: Q1 drain copper
copperArea.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, LED driver and ring: IRLR024N DS p.1 RθJA 110 °C/W minimum pad, 50 °C/W on 1 in² (0.73 W average at the 0.5 ms / 120 fps limit). Only ≈ 100–120 mm² fits: the Q1 tab, F.Cu beside it, and the B.Cu zone x 144.8–151.0, y 126.7–137.65 (clear of the crystal Y1/C5, the RMII B.Cu strip x 152.75–157.3, the CSI bus and U6), with ≥ 12 thermal vias in the tab (16 placed); never on the ring side. Q1 cannot move: no free 7.5 × 11.5 mm top area on the board (kicad_query board_free_space)

heightZones.name: lens view cone
heightZones.why: docs/hardware/layout.md, Camera and CSI-2: lens view cone: lens axis at the cutout centre; a top-side part h mm tall sits ≥ 7.0 + 0.83·h mm from it (r0: lens tip ≤ 5.4 mm below the top face, user decision 2026-10-31; slope tan(79.3°/2)); heights are the current parts' datasheet maxima (listed there)
